scope: Analytic cylinder/torus surface-surface intersection in the coaxial configuration (tenth analytic SS slice, one cell): native intersect_cylinder_torus in crates/brep-core/src/intersections/cylinder_torus.rs, bridge op brep_intersect_cylinder_torus, typed TS adapter intersectCylinderTorus. The cell reuses both existing recognizers unchanged (sphere_cylinder::recognize_cylinder for the exact canonical six-face cylinder solid — four rational circular side patches with weights [1, cos(pi/4), 1] and two bilinear caps with inscribed quarter-circle trims; plane_torus::recognize_torus for the exact sixteen-patch strict ring-torus solid with tensor-product weights [[1,w,1],[w,w^2,w],[1,w,1]], w = cos(pi/4), R - r >= 1e-5; rigid affine placements admitted). The cylinder operand is always first — swapped order is an explicit unsupported_surface region. Coaxiality is certified, never forced: a pure-rounding axis tilt (64 binary64 epsilons plus the recognition-error angular allowances) or center-line offset (64 epsilons of the axial/radius terms plus both recognition deviations) snaps to coaxial, a recognition-scale tilt or offset (1e-9) reports near_coincidence, and a clearly tilted or off-axis pair is unsupported_surface (the general cylinder/torus pair is a quartic, out of scope — no numerical fallback). Both surfaces are surfaces of revolution about the shared axis, so the section reduces to line/circle in the meridian half-plane (rho >= 0, z): the cylinder side rho = R_c against the torus meridian circle (rho - R)^2 + z^2 = r^2. Classification uses outward binary64 bands widened by both recognition deviations: |R_c - R| > r + band is a provable miss (resolves empty); |R_c - R| == r within the band is the tangent line (double root at z == 0 — the only configuration where the two roots would coincide) and stays tangency_or_multiple_root, never a guessed circle; otherwise z = +-sqrt(r^2 - (R_c - R)^2) are two distinct exact circles of radius R_c (a resolved branch therefore always yields exactly two circles — a single-circle meridian resolution is structurally unreachable, documented rather than tested), clipped by the cylinder's finite height (a circle provably beyond a cap plane is absent; a circle landing on a cap plane within the band is the rim tangency, unresolved). Cap-plane contacts: the cap plane at cylinder axial position q crosses the torus at torus-axial height h_c; |h_c| > r + band resolves empty, |h_c| == r within the band is the plane/tube tangency (unresolved), otherwise the two exact circles of radii R +- sqrt(r^2 - h_c^2) are admitted when provably inside the cap disk (radius < R_c - band), refused beyond it, and a radius equal to R_c within the band is the rim tangency (unresolved); the inner-radius collapse guard (R - sqrt(r^2 - h_c^2) <= band) is unreachable for a strict ring torus and kept as an honest guard. Resolved contacts are exact rational circles (degree 2, knots 0..=4, four 90-degree arcs, weights cos(pi/4)) with UV lifts on both surfaces: iso-v degree-1 lines at the exact height fraction on all four cylinder side patches, an exact UV circle (four arcs, radius rho/(2R_c) about [1/2, 1/2]) on a cap face, and iso-v torus parallels at the exact profile angle phi = atan2(z, rho - R) through the exact rational 90-degree-arc parameter map t = s/(1+s), s = sqrt(2) tan(phi/2)/(1 - tan(phi/2)) — one degree-1 line per revolution quadrant patch of the profile row. Every component carries a 16-sample residual bound against the cylinder side or cap plane equation and the scaled torus implicit equation. coincident_trim is deliberately unused (a cylinder side never coincides with a curved torus patch). Nothing here authorizes a topology change: permitsTopologyChange stays false and even numerically_resolved reports are numerical_uncertified.

RESOLVED cap-circle pairs: the short wide cylinder R_c=4.5 spanning -0.25..0.25 (|a|=1.5 > 1, no side contact) yields four cap circles of radii 3 +- sqrt(1 - 0.0625) at h_c = +-0.25 (oracles to 1e-12), each with the exact four-arc UV circle of radius rho/(2R_c) about [1/2, 1/2] on the cap face and the torus iso-v lifts at the exact profile angle

RESOLVED empty branches: the thin cylinder in the hole (line rho=1 misses the meridian circle), the short narrow cylinder R_c=1.5 spanning -0.5..0.5 (no side contact and both cap circle radii 3 +- sqrt(0.75) outside the disks), and the huge cylinder swallowing the whole torus all resolve numerically_resolved with no components and no unresolved regions, certified by the outward interval signs

RESOLVED just-across and placement configurations: R_c = 2 + 1e-9 resolves two small transverse circles around the inner equator; a cap plane just across the tube tangency (h_c = -(1 - 1e-9)) resolves two small cap circles; rigid placement of the whole coaxial configuration rotated about X by 0.5 and translated keeps the exact circle pair against the placed oracles to 1e-12 with UV lifts verified through the placed patch surfaces to 1e-9

UNRESOLVED tangencies: the meridian line/circle tangencies R_c == R - r = 2 and R_c == R + r = 4 (and within the band, 2 +- 2e-15, 4 +- 2e-15) stay tangency_or_multiple_root with no components — the double root at z == 0 is the only coincident-root configuration and is never guessed; the rim tangency (R_c = 2.5, half height sqrt(0.75): both side circles land on the cap planes and the inner cap circle radius equals R_c) stays unresolved with no components; the cap-plane tube tangency (|h_c| == r) stays unresolved; a miss just clear of the tangency band (R_c = 2 - 1e-9, caps 2 + 1e-9 beyond the tube) resolves empty

UNRESOLVED near-coaxial bands: a center-line offset of 1e-10 and a 1e-10 rad axis tilt report near_coincidence, never forced coaxial; a clearly off-axis pair (0.5 offset) and a clearly tilted pair (0.3 rad) are unsupported_surface with the full 8-number parameter box

REFUSED non-canonical operands: sphere/torus, cuboid/torus, torus/torus, swapped order (torus first), cylinder/sphere and a structurally perturbed torus (one moved control point) are explicit unsupported_surface regions, never a numerical fallback; a canonical pair through the same path still resolves

UNVERIFIED by construction: the single-circle meridian resolution is structurally unreachable (roots coincide only at the tangent double root, which is always unresolved) and is documented rather than tested; the inner-radius collapse guard is unreachable for a canonical strict ring torus (R - r >= 1e-5) and kept as an honest guard
behaviorChange: New read-only query intersectCylinderTorus (brep_intersect_cylinder_torus); all recognizers and helpers are reused unchanged (no edits to sphere_cylinder.rs, plane_torus.rs or sphere_sphere.rs); no existing query, op, or adapter behavior changed. Dist budgets unchanged: the geometry chunk is 2,453,043 bytes (measured, +3,900 over 2,449,143) and the total is 4,771,577 bytes (measured, +3,900 over 4,767,677) — both stay within the existing budgets (2,455,000 chunk, 4,775,000 total).

limits.classificationBand: both recognition deviations + 16 binary64 epsilons of the axial/radius terms
limits.axialSnapBand: axis tilt: 64 binary64 epsilons plus the recognition-error angular allowances; center-line offset: 64 binary64 epsilons of the axial/radius terms plus both recognition deviations (pure-rounding only); recognition-scale tilts/offsets report near_coincidence
limits.isoParameterMap: exact rational 90-degree-arc parameter map t = s/(1+s), s = sqrt(2) tan(phi/2)/(1 - tan(phi/2)) (discriminant exactly 2); seam contacts snap at 64 epsilons of the unit parameter interval

limitations: Canonical operands only: the cylinder is the exact canonical six-face cylinder solid; the torus is the exact canonical strict ring-torus solid (R - r >= 1e-5; horn and spindle tori are refused at construction); everything else is an explicit unsupported_surface region, never a numerical fallback

Coaxial configuration only: the cylinder axis must be certified coincident with the torus axis; clearly tilted or off-axis pairs are honest unsupported_surface regions (the general cylinder/torus pair is a quartic) with a near_coincidence band at recognition scale, never forced coaxial

Resolved sections are the two-circle side family (the single-circle meridian resolution is structurally unreachable — the roots coincide only at the tangent) plus the cap-circle pairs R +- sqrt(r^2 - h_c^2) clipped to the cap disks; the meridian tangency (double root at z == 0), rim contacts (a side circle on a cap plane, or a cap circle radius equal to R_c) and the cap-plane tube tangency (|h_c| == r) stay tangency_or_multiple_root — tangent contacts are never guessed circles
coincident_trim is deliberately unused: a cylinder side can never coincide with a curved torus patch

NumericallyResolved is not certified complete-domain coverage and permitsTopologyChange stays false; consuming these sections in Booleans and the remaining analytic SS pairs (cone/torus, torus/torus) stay open
